candidates: When migration docs or other documentation links to external code examples (e.g., in addon-kit or another repo), consider whether to link to the final file on the default branch or to a PR diff. Linking to a PR diff is acceptable — and often preferable — when the purpose is to show readers exactly what changes to make in their own code; if that is the intent, ensure the surrounding prose makes it explicit so readers know to follow the diff pattern rather than simply copying the end result.
